title: A Gauge-Invariant Bundle Isomorphism Between Complex Velocity Fields and Symmetric Logarithmic Derivatives
summary: We establish a rigorous bundle isomorphism between the complex velocity field $η_μ = π_μ - i u_μ$, obtained by averaging matter dynamics over stochastic gravitational fluctuations, and the symmetric logarithmic derivative (SLD) operator $L_μ$ of quantum estimation theory.
